K1: ["Apple","banana","APPLE","Cherry","banana","date","Date","elderberry"] | * (lower) | unique | count
K2: | filter (/status | eq "paid") | group-by /customer | map-values (* (/total | default 0) | sum)
K3: | split "\n" | filter (. != "") | * (split " " | /1) | group-by (.) | map-values count
K4: | [(/dependencies | to-entries), (/devDependencies | to-entries)] | flatten | filter (/1 | starts-with "^") | * /0 | unique | sort
K5: | filter (/state | eq "open") | sort-by [(/comments | default 0 | neg) /id] | take 3 | * /id
K6: | split "\n" | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter (/2 | lower | eq "de") | filter (/1 | ne "") | * (/1 | number) | average | round 1
K7: | /services | to-entries | filter (/1 | /enabled) | filter (/1 | /port | type | eq number) | sort-by (/1 | /port) | * (/0 + ":" + (/1 | /port | string))
K8: | /results | filter (/email | ne null) | filter (/email | split "@" | /1 | lower | eq "example.com") | filter (/user/name/last | ne null) | * (/user/name/last + ", " + /user/name/first)
K9: | filter (/user | ne null) | filter (/action | lower | eq "login") | * (/user | lower) | unique | sort
K10: | filter (/salary | ne null) | group-by /dept | map-values (* /salary | average | round 2)
K11: | * /tags | filter (ne null) | filter (ne "") | * (split "," | * (trim | lower) | filter (ne "")) | flatten | group-by (.) | map-values count | to-entries | sort-by [(/1 | neg) /0] | take 3 | * /0
K12: | split "\n" | filter (ne "") | filter (/0 | ne "#") | * (split "|" | (/1 | number) * (/2 | number)) | sum | round 2
K13: | /services | filter (/env | lower | eq "prod") | * (/replicas | default 1 | ge 2) | all
K14: | * {:id /id :itemCount (/items | default [] | * /qty | sum)} | filter (/itemCount | gt 0) | sort-by [(/itemCount | neg) /id] | take 3
